events.title: Proposed ruling: refund_full $6.61 (model confidence 0.90)
events.body:
The rider cancelled the RydeX trip 2 min 30 s (150 s) after acceptance [F2]. NS-0 routes a rider-side cancellation to NS-4 [NS-0], and under NS-4 the $6.61 cancellation fee only stands if the rider cancels more than 3 minutes (180 s) after matching; cancellations within 3 minutes are not chargeable [NS-4]. The trace confirms 150 s < 180 s, so the fee condition never matured and the $6.61 charged [F5] must be returned in full [NS-4].

The driver-side no-show framework is not in play here: the driver never tapped "I'm Here" [F4][NS-1(i)] and the platform never recorded arrival at the pickup point [F3], while GPS shows the driver never came within 200 m of the pickup, closest approach 1806 m [F1]. On these facts NS-2 would also independently require a full refund, but the operative route is NS-4 because the cancellation was made by the rider [F2][NS-0][NS-2].

The driver's message about arriving in "about 5 min, traffic" [F8] and the driver's statement that he was on his way [F9] do not defeat the refund: NS-4 does not condition the rider's free-cancellation window on the driver's proximity or ETA, and the moderate speed-band reading on BOON LAY WAY is band 3, not the band 1–2 congestion proxy, and is not tied to a claimed detour [F10][F11][RD-4(b)]. Surge was 1.0×, so no surge component exists to adjust [F6][RD-2].

Amount: the only sum on record and trace is the cancellation fee itself, $6.61 [F5][F2][NS-4]; there is no metered distance fare to apply the RD-2 per-km formula to, and the rider's requested relief is the fee only [F1][F5][RD-2]. The cancellation-fee refund is issued as a non-cash voucher per NS-7 [NS-7].

No clause calls for an account flag: the rider cancelled, the driver's "I'm Here" was never pressed so the NS-2 abuse-flag trigger is absent, and the driver's profile shows no upheld route-deviation dispute [F4][F14][NS-2][RD-6].

RIDER: Good news — your cancellation fee is being refunded in full. You cancelled 2 minutes 30 seconds after a driver accepted, and fees only apply once a cancellation comes more than 3 minutes after matching. Since you were inside that window, the $6.61 you were charged shouldn't have been taken. We're returning it as a Ryde voucher, which you can use on your next trip. Nothing else changes on your account, and no further action is needed from you.

DRIVER: We've reviewed the cancelled trip and the $6.61 cancellation fee has been refunded to the rider. The rider cancelled within 3 minutes of you accepting, so the fee wasn't chargeable. The record also shows you never tapped "I'm Here" and never reached the pickup point, but that isn't held against you here: the deciding factor was the timing of the cancellation. No flag or penalty has been placed on your account. Keep accepting and completing trips as usual.
